text:
1-Star Review for McDonald's - Makati, Philippines

Nine months ago, McDonald's in Makati near AirResidence was our go-to spot for late-night meals. The food was decent, and it was a reliable choice for us during our stay. However, our recent visit has been nothing short of a nightmare.

Fast forward to now, we returned to AirResidence for our vacation and decided to visit this branch again, expecting the same quality. To our utter disappointment, the food was absolutely terrible. The meals we ordered were burnt and completely tasteless. It felt like we were being served inedible garbage.

To make matters worse, our meal cost over 600 pesos. Imagine in a context for a family earning around 15,000 pesos a month, McDonald's used to be a place where you could treat themselves without breaking the bank. Now, it feels like throwing money away for a treat, only to be served such awful food. It's incredibly disheartening and frustrating, knowing it will take another month to afford such an outing again.

This McDonald's branch has truly gone downhill. I wouldn't recommend it to anyone looking for a decent meal, let alone a pleasant dining experience. Save your money and your stomach—avoid this place at all costs.
author: TasteTravellers Digital Creators

text: To the management of McDonald's. As a big fastfood chain I don't know if you're familiar with the roots of your company. If not, try to check the movie "The Founder", starring Michael Keaton. it was about how people fell in love with McDonald's and it's way of serving food. efficiency. Which brings us to the topic of your new serving system "wait & claim". The food you serve is basically the same as it was before. A few added options on the menu but still it's not much. I understand that food has to be prepared and at some point, we as customers do have to wait. It's just that, I have observed that your crew (counter) is always so eager to serve the next customer rather than serving the ones who are already paid, thus the waiting game. I saw another review from another person who also noticed this. It's kinda annoying to see how branch managers allow a quality of service such as this. I remember McDonald's used to serve their food while you pay. Whatever happened to that?
author: Niko Say
